questions.title: Do you accept this test scope: these seams and their required failure paths?
questions.text:
Seams and required injected failure paths (plan.md, "Test seams"):
1. factory_cli.checks.gate_violation(state, "implement"): CRITICAL > 0; HIGH > 0 including a new HIGH on a clean baseline; total exactly half (12 -> 6) and above; LOW exactly half (6 -> 3); odd baseline (7 -> 4); zero baseline with nonzero latest (LOW 0 -> 1); pending_clarify non-empty with targets met; unanswered requires_user relay question; no baseline with zero reports, several reports, or a result naming another report.
2. factory_cli.checks.gate_violation(state, "remediate"): loops == 2 with no decision; an auto: true analyze decision; a guided decision older than analyze.result.at.
3. bin/factory analyze-record: --fresh-baseline with an existing or derivable baseline is refused, with state and HEAD unchanged.
4. bin/factory checkpoint (remediate and into implement): a repeated checkpoint remediate after the stage advanced does not increment; a refused transition into remediate at the cap leaves state unchanged; the transition into implement after remediate with the stale pre-remediation result is refused until a fresh analysis is recorded.
5. bin/factory resume (baseline and loops preserved on another harness): none.
6. factory_cli.state.validate_state (analyze.baseline shape): negative count; missing count; non-integer count; empty report.
7. bin/factory amendment-check: missing draft exits 1; changed draft (hash mismatch) exits 1; constitution file byte-identical after each.
Exempt (documentation only): DESIGN.md, docs/adr/0014-analyze-acceptance-targets.md, core/skills/factory/SKILL.md, core/skills/factory/references/state.md, core/roles/spec-builder.md. Overridden: none.
